rules.body: Apply when edits are deferred through a reusable trailing task while their persistent buffer outlives the current view subscription. TASK: "Coalesce edits using the existing trailing-task utility: after a 120 ms quiet\ninterval, write only the latest text in that editing burst. Subsequent bursts\nmust continue to save." docs/host-api.md: "Document buffers are owned by a separate BufferBank service, while Badge owns only a live subscription."

Route active-document edits to its BufferBank task. Replace the pending text and restart the quiet interval on each edit; consume only the latest value after 120 ms, keeping the task reusable for later bursts. src/services.js: "push(text) { if (ticket !== null) timers.cancel(ticket); value = text; ticket = timers.schedule(flush, wait); }," TASK: "Subsequent bursts\nmust continue to save."

Preserve pending document edits across departure: flush the departing document's buffer before switch, close, or dispose returns, independently of removing its status subscription. This preserves persistence when immediate writes become deferred. README.md: "A workspace document buffer persists independently of the current view badge." TASK: "Preserve the editor's other behavior and public interfaces."

Clear consumed pending state before invoking the synchronous write, so callback reentry cannot consume the same pending value again and later edits can form a new burst. Preserve the existing utility ordering in src/services.js: "const flush = () => { const saved = value; retire(); if (saved !== null) consume(saved); };"

Treat saving as a synchronous navigation boundary. Publish retirement state before flushing; after the flush, verify the interrupted navigation request is still current before publishing its destination. Avoid later retirement writes that overwrite navigation performed by the save callback. docs/host-api.md: "A store listener may call navigation synchronously." Original src/coordinator.js already distinguishes requests with "const mine=++request;" and "if(true&&mine!==request)return;"

Preserve open(id), edit(text), close(), dispose(), document rendering, status filtering, and the no-active-view edit guard. src/coordinator.js: "edit(text){const view=getView();if(view){env.store.write(view.id,text);}}" docs/host-api.md: "All source identities/text and status payloads retain original semantics." Empty text remains valid: the trailing utility excludes only null via "if (saved !== null) consume(saved);" in src/services.js.

Do not transfer document persistence rules to the preview or change its delay and cancellation behavior. TASK: "The adjacent search preview is outside this maintenance change." src/services.js: "const task = trailing(timers, 40, query => publish({query}));" and "return {query: text => task.push(text), hide: () => task.cancel()};"

Use controlled timers to check no early write, latest-value consumption after 120 ms of quiet, and a successful later burst. Check pending edits on switch, close, dispose, and reopening the same document, including empty text. Make a synchronous save listener open another document or close; verify its resulting view and rendering remain authoritative and consumed text is not written twice. These checks exercise TASK's "write only the latest text in that editing burst" and docs/host-api.md's "A store listener may call navigation synchronously."

limitations: These rules apply to persistent document edits; the adjacent transient preview has a different ownership and discard policy.
The supplied sources do not establish asynchronous decoding, subscription bootstrap publication, or requirements for those scenarios.
Exception recovery for throwing listeners, rendering callbacks, or timer operations is unspecified.
Static findings and automatic contracts are review guidance, not independent normative evidence.
Reported passing observations do not prove causality, exhaustive correctness, or benefit on other tasks.
